articles.title: US-Iran war: Dubai, UAE air traffic operations return to normal after temporary closure of country's airspace
articles.summary: Air traffic in the United Arab Emirates has resumed normal operations following the lifting of temporary precautionary measures. State news agency WAM reported this development, citing the UAE's General Civil Aviation Authority. This signifies a restoration of regular flight schedules and safety protocols, reassuring passengers and airlines about the region's operational stability after a period of disruption.

articles.title: Indiana Jones as You Have Never Seen It Before (31 pics)
articles.summary: This unique photo diary provides an exclusive behind-the-scenes look into the making of the iconic film “Raiders of the Lost Ark”. It captures candid moments of the cast and crew, showing them interacting, joking around, and meticulously preparing for various camera shots. The diary offers valuable insights into the movie-making process, showcasing the camaraderie and efforts involved in producing the cinematic masterpiece.
